title: Nf Maxorder Corpus
objective: Build the durable certified maximal-order corpus from PARI Round-4, selected Hecke absolute-field regressions, Sage cases, hard families, and equivalent-generator fuzzing with provenance and canonical digests

handoff.summary: Added the 494-case stable maximal-order authority: all 430 PARI Round-4 vector polynomials, named/derived PARI cases, six selected Hecke absolute-field regressions, existing Sage.js cases, and scalable equivalent-generator families. The manifest contains exact discriminants and indices, proof-state-aware local components, 493 canonical basis digests, provenance, certification state, bounded oracle outcomes, and a deterministic structural gate.
risks: The degree-4 large-prime compositum intentionally has no basis digest because GP 2.17.3 overflows its nfbasis hint boundary; its exact polynomial, discriminants, index, factors, and unavailable state are retained.
Five stress bases are digest-only to keep the fixture bounded; the checked generator/oracles are needed to materialize them.
426 cases retain probable-prime or unresolved composite local components. They multiply to the exact index but are not falsely advertised as certified prime support.

pnpm docs:check reached the pre-existing stale generated-reference-docs gate, and pnpm test:tutorial reported the broad base runtime's existing 326 pass / 336 fail result with optional native adapters unavailable. Neither failure involved corpus files; integration should regenerate central docs and rerun broad validation on main-1.
next_steps: Make benchmark and profiler lanes consume test/fixtures/number-field-maximal-order-corpus.json as their only polynomial/result authority.
Have the independent Sage.js certificate checker promote local component and certification states as implementations land, without weakening frozen exact invariants.
Resolve the one explicit basis debt with a non-machine-word native boundary and optionally materialize digest-only stress bases in an external artifact.
